title: Generated code and coverage

requirement.summary: Generated MessagePack code should be excluded from code coverage without hiding user-authored behavior.
requirement.details: Generated output containing an attribute is not evidence that a coverage tool excludes precisely the intended code. Separate generator changes from regenerated expected-output snapshots.
